narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation Spiral
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as multiple theaters of conflict (Iran, Israel, Ukraine) escalate simultaneously, with asymmetric threats and kinetic exchanges contradicting diplomatic off-ramp narratives. The market is underpricing the duration and breadth of these conflicts, as evidenced by the EIA's extended Hormuz blockade timeline and the failure of 'one-and-done' expectations.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI crude oil and short S&P 500 futures; overweight gold and long-dated US Treasuries as hedges against sustained geopolitical risk premium.

narratives.title: Oil Supply Disruption Permanence
narratives.summary: Capital is rotating into energy commodities as the Strait of Hormuz blockade persists structurally, with Kuwait seeking bypass pipelines and the EIA raising WTI forecasts. The US SPR release is being misread as bearish but actually signals government concern over sustained supply tightness, supporting a bullish oil thesis.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI futures and energy sector ETFs; consider long-dated call spreads on oil to capture upside from prolonged disruption.

narratives.title: Risk-Off Liquidity Cascade
narratives.summary: Equity markets are breaking below key technical levels amid geopolitical shocks, with selling accelerated by algorithmic stop-loss cascades rather than fundamental repricing. Bitcoin's crash mirrors macro risk-off sentiment, but whale accumulation and institutional dip-buying suggest the selloff is tactical, not structural.
narratives.trade_implication: Short S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures tactically; consider long VIX calls for tail risk protection, but avoid shorting Bitcoin as whales may support a rebound.
